title: Astra on the Skunk Works org chart

tellings.quote: Instead, what I saw above it was something called Astra.

plain: Between 1993 and 1996, a writer named Nick Cook says he was shown an organisation chart of the Skunk Works, the aircraft maker Lockheed's secret design unit in Palmdale, California, and that at the top of it, above the place he expected, was something called Astra. Cook says he saw this himself and recorded it in his diaries. He tells it as a sign that a hidden program, perhaps tied to antigravity research, sat above even the Skunk Works.
